card.name: Legal requirement wording (must, required)
card.fires_on: The word 'must' or 'required to', or the word right after it, when a rule, law or regulation obliges companies or institutions to do something. It is strongest when the subject is a manufacturer, college or municipality.

modes.label: Obligation verb
modes.description: 'must', 'requires' or 'required to' stating what a regulated party has to do.
